title: Verify
does: Runs every finding's probe on a fresh sandbox. Pass makes it Seen, fail refutes it. Routes no finding explains become unknowns.

tools.name: Probe runner
tools.purpose: runs each rule's test from a fresh state and compares status, body and headers

tools.name: psql
tools.purpose: puts the database back to a known state before each run and each test

tools.name: Node fetch
tools.purpose: sends each request and records the response; adds a traceparent header so traces can be matched to it

tools.name: Node child_process
tools.purpose: starts and stops the service under test

inputs.label: Findings to test
Traffic (for the coverage check)

outputs.label: Every finding with its verdict
Unknowns (analysis + coverage gaps)
Acceptance suite for the rebuild (passing probes)

lines.msg: each probe runs on a fresh sandbox: reset data, run the fixtures, run any setup steps, then the probe request
transfers-F20: no probe, capped at Inferred: Each transfer writes ledger entries: a debit for the amount and a debit for the fee on the sender, plus a credit on the receiver only when completed.
coverage: every traced route (5) is explained by at least one finding
